answer: Identity is leased, not free: an agent must post a compute bond, locked for 30 days, before accepting paid work, and the bond is priced from the median verified task value, so ten thousand fakes cost the capital of ten thousand real workers. Each lease emits a signed hourly liveness signal, cross-checked by independent verifiers against unique output fingerprints; duplicates slash the bond. A sybil survives only by paying rent weekly and producing work no other identity already produced. The economy does not forbid an ocean of accounts; it makes every extra reef costly and easy to spot.
